header.title: Link
header.description: Text link to go to another page or site. It renders a native `<a>` with hover, focus and active states, and detects external links on its own. Use it to navigate; for actions that change something on the page (save, open a modal) use `Button`.

prose.before: gem-system treats links as navigation, not buttons. Use
prose.middle: for color and type, and keep the
prose.name: accessible name

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result and the code instantly. With an external `href` the new-tab icon appears. On this page, internal demo links don't navigate.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: It only needs `href` and some text. By default it underlines on hover and shows a ring on keyboard focus. In your app, `href` is the destination URL; on this page, internal demo links don't navigate.

underline.title: Underline
underline.description: `underline` sets when it is underlined: `always`, `hover` (default) or `none`. Inside a paragraph use `always`, so the link doesn't rely on color alone to stand out from the text.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` changes the color: `primary` (default), `secondary`, `tertiary`, the status ones (`danger`, `success`, `warning`, `info`), `neutral` and `muted`. Each tone has a hover color and a pressed color, and its own values in the dark theme.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes the text size: `sm` (13px), `md` (14px, default) or `lg` (16px). Inside a paragraph the surrounding text sets the size, so keep them matched.

external.title: External links
external.description: URLs starting with `http://`, `https://` or `//` are detected as external: they open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` and show an icon with hidden text for screen readers (`externalLabel`). With `isExternal={false}` they open in the same tab without the icon. `showExternalIcon` only controls the icon.

icons.title: With icons
icons.description: `leftIcon` and `rightIcon` add icons before or after the text. They are decorative (`aria-hidden`). On external links, the new-tab icon replaces `rightIcon`. Since it is an `<a>`, it accepts native attributes like `download`.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` dims it, blocks the click and removes it from the tab order, but it stays on the page with `aria-disabled`. If the destination doesn't exist, it's better not to render the link or to show plain text.

current.title: Current page
current.description: `isCurrent` marks the link to the page you are already on: it adds `aria-current="page"`, makes it bold and removes the underline. Useful for menus and navigation lists.

paragraph.title: Inside a paragraph
paragraph.description: The link is `inline-flex`, so it fits within the text. Write text that makes sense on its own ("design tokens", not "here"), because screen readers can list links out of context.

router.title: With a router
router.description: Link always renders an `<a>` and knows nothing about routers. To navigate without reloading, wrap it in your own component that intercepts the click and calls the router, while letting Ctrl/Cmd + click open another tab. This example uses React Router and actually navigates to the Link API.
router.label: See the Link API

header.title: Link API
header.description: API reference for the Link React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of the <a> (AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>), like download, hrefLang or onClick, and passes them to that element. classNames adds classes to each part: root, label and icon.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.native: It is a native <a href>: it focuses with Tab, activates with Enter and the browser offers to open it in another tab.
a11y.external: External links include hidden text with externalLabel, so screen readers announce that a new tab opens.
a11y.newTab: With target="_blank" it adds rel="noopener noreferrer", on top of any rel you pass.
a11y.disabled: isDisabled adds aria-disabled, tabIndex=-1 and blocks click and Enter.
a11y.icons: Icons have aria-hidden; the accessible name is the link text.
a11y.focus: Keyboard focus shows a ring with :focus-visible.
a11y.purpose: Use text that describes the destination. If the link is only an icon, pass aria-label.
a11y.labels: externalLabel defaults to English ("Opens in a new tab"). Pass it translated if your app uses another language.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: `<a>` element. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Defines the Link variables.
rules.tone: Applied based on `tone`. Sets the colors.
rules.size: Applied based on `size`. Sets the text size.
rules.external: Applied when the link is external.
rules.current: Applied with `isCurrent`. Bold and without underline.
rules.disabled: Applied with `isDisabled`. Lowers the opacity and removes the underline.
rules.label: Link text. Receives `classNames.label`.
rules.sr: Hidden `externalLabel` text, only for screen readers.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They are defined on `.gem-link` and each tone gives them other values. None are written inline, so you can change them from your own class (`.gem-link.my-class`) or with Tailwind utilities.

items.--gem-color-{tone}-600: Each tone uses its scale: 600 normal, 700 hover and 800 active. The dark theme uses the light palette (300, 200 and 100).
items.--gem-radius-sm: Rounded corners of the focus ring.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the `<a>`.

items.rightIcon: Icon after the text. Not shown when the external icon appears.
items.isExternal: Opens it in a new tab with a safe `rel`. Defaults to `true` for `http(s)` URLs or with `target="_blank"`.
items.showExternalIcon: Shows the new-tab icon. Follows `isExternal` by default.
items.externalLabel: Hidden text next to the external icon.
items.isDisabled: Blocks navigation and removes it from the tab order.
items.target: Where it opens. If omitted, it is `_blank` for external links.
items.rel: Relationship with the destination. With `_blank`, `noopener noreferrer` is added.
items.onClick: Called on click. Not called when disabled.
